instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a slightly high angle shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, extending his left arm to touch the shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing forward with a neutral expression. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
elements: R1 initiates shoulder contact by extending his arm toward R2
R2 receives the shoulder touch from R1 rather than touching R1
R1 faces toward R2 while making contact with her shoulder
R2 stands facing forward while being touched on the shoulder by R1
